title: Day 75: Teuchitlán Network Collapse Confirmed via El Cabo Arrest; State Dept Reviews 53 Mexican Consulates; 34 Days to FIFA World Cup
detail: Day 75 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). TEUCHITLÁN NETWORK DISMANTLEMENT — 75-DAY LEDGER: The May 7 arrest of 'El Cabo' (Fernando Daniel Farías de la Cruz) — CJNG's forced-recruiter for the Rancho Izaguirre / 'La Galera' compound in Teuchitlán — confirms a methodical FGR strategy targeting the full operational chain of the Teuchitlán extermination infrastructure: El Jardinero (Fractura Total commander, arrested April 27) → El Güero Conta (financial operator, arrested April 27) → El Cabo (recruiter, arrested May 7, Ciudad Acuña). Rancho Izaguirre/La Galera, where forensic teams identified nearly 100 DNA samples and bone fragments predating 2015, was the training-disappearance hub that linked El Sapo's military faction to CJNG's systematic crimes. Infobae reported additional detail on El Cabo on May 8. STATE DEPARTMENT CONSULATE REVIEW — BILATERAL ESCALATION: The U.S. State Department began a formal review of all 53 Mexican consulates operating in U.S. territory, according to CBS News — a measure reflecting escalating bilateral tensions across four simultaneous pressure tracks: (1) CIA-Chihuahua sovereignty crisis (constitutional deadlock, Maru Campos declined April 28 Senate hearing); (2) DOJ SDNY indictment of Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya + 9 officials (unsealed April 30; Rocha Moya took 'temporary leave' May 2); (3) Sheinbaum's 'irrefutable proof' extradition standard (announced May 6); (4) ongoing CJNG interdiction framework. The consulate review — while framed as administrative — represents the Trump administration's most concrete bilateral diplomatic escalation since the February 22 El Mencho operation. SUCCESSION BINARY — DAY 75: El 03 (Juan Carlos Valencia González, financial-organizational wing, confirmed CJNG leader — El País, April 6) vs. El Sapo (Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán, military wing, Federal Security Cabinet top-2 target — named May 3). El Sapo remains at large. DECAPITATION CAMPAIGN — 75-DAY LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27, formally charged May 4), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. WORLD CUP COUNTDOWN: 34 days to FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Mexico City). Guadalajara hosts 4 group-stage matches; Mexico's 130,000-person nationwide security deployment continues.
